about: The Dardenne Creek watershed covers about 163 square miles of St. Charles County. It is made up of 3 smaller watersheds: Upper Dardenne Creek, Middle Dardenne Creek and Lower Dardenne Creek. Click one to open it. The land ranges from about 830 feet above sea level at its highest point to about 420 feet at its lowest. Its main streams are Dardenne Creek, Belleau Creek, Little Dardenne Creek and Cole Creek. Communities here include O'Fallon, St. Peters, St. Charles, Dardenne Prairie, Cottleville and Weldon Spring. All of its water ends up in the Mississippi River.
